rows.en: General Jark… I, Maribaron, humbly offer my service to you, General, for what little it is worth.
Nuooooh…
General Jark…
Uuugh…
General Jark! As the strongest monster, Jark Midora, strike down those Kamen Riders!
Your Majesty…

Jark Midora! His Majesty has bestowed mighty powers upon you!

Use that power to the full… defeat the Kamen Riders, and repay His Majesty's kindness!
Nuooooh…

There are too many humans here for us to welcome five billion people from our homeland!!

Volunteers of the battle-fleet nation Naager!! Send in Gigant at once! Spare those strong in body who will work for us, and slaughter all the rest!
This is a human hunt!!
Yes, sir…
Maribaron! Invite a man named Kotaro Minami to our underground fortress in Jigokudani!
Invite him?
Kyaa…
A lightning strike!? And it isn't even raining…
Don't tell me… it's an omen of some natural disaster…

No… This must be Crisis's doing…

Just as Kotaro said, they're trying to change Earth's environment so they can welcome their emigrants.
If they do that, the elderly and people in poor health won't be able to bear it, will they?
Whoa whoa…
Lightning!? And it isn't even raining…
If they do that, the elderly and people in poor health won't stand a chance…

…!?

What? Why isn't anyone surprised?

Oh… So the Crisis Empire has finally made its move?

As for information about them, we all know it from Kotaro!

He's been investigating the Crisis Empire's movements all on his own this whole time.

Huh… No, I mean…

It's a human hunt!
A human hunt?
That's terrible! Why didn't you say so sooner!?

Wh-what do you expect me to…

Anyway, the city's in an uproar. They're grabbing people indiscriminately!
Damn… So that's how the Crisis Empire works!? We won't let them do as they please!
This is awful…
How could they…

Innocent people, like this…

I won't forgive them! Everyone, let's go!
Looks like we're surrounded, huh?
Yeah… Are you ready? Let's go!
Your Majesty, Crisis Emperor… By your order, I, Maribaron, have brought Kotaro Minami…
Crisis Emperor! I, Kotaro Minami… have accepted your invitation and come! Let's hear what you have to say.

Kotaro Minami, who is also Kamen Rider BLACK!

I am the ruler of the Kaima World and the Emperor of the Crisis Empire!

I recognize you as a hero without equal on Earth, and hereby grant you the Crisis Empire's highest title, "Sir"!

Whoa, hold on!

I'm honored by the praise… but I have no intention of accepting any rank from you… Never mind that, let's start the talks!

I value your strength and abilities more than anyone, you know.

I am even prepared to entrust you with the rule of Earth!
Me, the ruler of Earth…?
Yes… As Supreme Commander of the Crisis Empire, you will rule and reign over Earth!

Please wait, Your Majesty!

To grant the post of Supreme Commander to such a whelp… I cannot believe these are Your Majesty's words!
Silence, Maribaron! Do you dare defy my word!?

Even if it is Your Majesty's word, that is the one thing I cannot obey!

The Supreme Commander is General Jark! General Jark will surely dispose of the Kamen Riders and defeat this man as well!

To hand over the post of Supreme Commander to this whelp at such a time would be as good as throwing away our victory… It must never be!

…!?

Who on earth are you…!?

…!?

Who on earth are you…!?

I am Granzairus, emissary of the Crisis Emperor!

I have been sent to defeat you and destroy your cities!
Granzairus…?
Granzairus…?
Hmm… Kotaro, what is your answer?

Crisis Emperor…

The Earth I want… is one where every living thing and all of nature live together in harmony! Earth doesn't need a ruler!

All it needs… is a heart that loves the Earth!
Kotaro, I shall ask once more… Do you have no intention of becoming Earth's ruler and reigning over it?
None!
What a ridiculous idea!
Then you shall leave this world as a nameless young man…
What!?

Kotaro Minami… The talks have broken down!

By the Crisis Emperor's command, we now begin the invasion of Earth! Die together with your comrades! We'll send you all to hell in one go!

Ha ha ha…
Who on earth are you…!?
Senpai! Are you all right!? Pull yourself together!

Kotaro…!? Where have you been all this time? Ugh…

The enemy… is Crisis's strongest Kaima Beastman, Granzairus! A fearsome opponent…
Even all of us together, it didn't feel like we could win at all…
He truly is the strongest Kaima Beastman…
Granzairus…
So you're the monster sent from Crisis!?

So you're Kotaro Minami… Kamen Rider BLACK!?

Hehehe… With firepower as feeble as yours, you'll never defeat me!
Heh heh heh… Come at me, all of you at once!!
Hen… shin!

I am Kamen Rider BLACK!

Crisis Empire… Strongest Kaima Beastman Granzairus! We won't hand Earth over to you!

Grr… The strongest Kaima Beastman Granzairus, defeated…

Now… our only hope is Jark Midora…!
My name is… Supreme Commander of the Crisis Empire, the strongest monster, Jark Midora!
Jark Midora…?
Jark Midora…?
Kotaro Minami… I demand a one-on-one duel!
Bring it on! Here I come!
Bring it on! Here I come!
…!? You!? Who are you?

U07724: Taki stammering, as if surprised that everyone already knows; then blurts the news.
U07736/U07744: 余/そち rendered as plain I/you in a regal register.
U07747/U07760: 最強怪魔獣人 rendered "strongest Kaima Beastman" per glossary.
U07762: グランザイラス referred to as "He".
